title: ChickenPack
description: This is a mod pack for 26.2 that makes the game run better, look and feel nicer and some quality of life improvements.
body:
![ChickenPack logo with to baby chicks on each side of the logo. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d10e6a0bf36e688047f334b2e67e022a51a8f0c7.png)
Welcome to ChickenPack! 🐥

This is my personal modpack that I use on my Minecraft Realm. It’s a carefully curated collection of mods focused on **performance**, **visuals**, **audio**, and **quality-of-life** improvements - all while staying as lightweight and stable as possible.

Whether you're exploring, building, or just chilling with friends, ChickenPack makes the game feel smoother, prettier, and more enjoyable without adding unnecessary bloat.

![A devider made up by eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a508cb7ea194f313d0e14051a60c12210d732ba.png)

### Included Mods:
- AmbientSounds
- AppleSkin
- Atmosfera
- Borderless Fullscreen
- Chat Heads
- ClickThrough+
- ClientSort
- Cloth Config
- Continuity
- Controlify
- Conures Graves
- CreativeCore
- Dynamic FPS
- Elytra Physics
- ElytraFlow
- Entity Culling
- Fabric API + Language Kotlin
- Falling Leaves
- FerriteCore
- ForgeConfigAPI Port
- Iris (Shaders)
- Jade
- LambDynamicLights
- Lithium
- Locator Heads
- ModMenu
- PingView
- Placeholder API
- Presence Footsteps *(disabled)*
- PuzzlesLib
- Reese's Sodium Options
- RespawnKpts
- RRLS
- Scribble
- ShulkerBoxTooltip
- Skin Layers 3D
- Sodium + Sodium Extra
- Sound Physics Remastered
- Visuality
- Visual Workbench
- Vivecraft
- Simple Voice Chat
- WaveyCapes
- XdBar
- YetAnotherConfigLib
- Zoomify

![A devider made up by eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a508cb7ea194f313d0e14051a60c12210d732ba.png)

**Note:**  
You’ll need to provide your own resource packs and shader packs to get the full visual experience. Some mods (like Iris + Sodium) work best with compatible shaders.

This pack emphasises buttery-smooth performance thanks to Lithium, Sodium, Entity Culling, and Dynamic FPS, while enhancing immersion with better audio (Ambient Sounds, Sound Physics, Presence Footsteps), improved visuals (Iris, Skin Layers, WaveyCapes, etc.), and handy QoL tools.
